page.content:
Terror army of blue troopers led by Cobra Commander, Destro, and the Baroness.

How Cobra connects

  • Character: Cobra Commander — Cobra Commander founded and leads Cobra.
  • Work: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero — Cobra is the enemy organization of A Real American Hero.
  • Faction: G.I. Joe team — The Joe team exists to stop Cobra.
  • Creator: The Baroness — The Baroness is Cobra's intelligence officer.
  • Character: Destro — Destro arms Cobra through M.A.R.S. while remaining a client, not a trooper.
  • Character: Storm Shadow — Storm Shadow serves Cobra as an Arashikage ninja before later breaking away.
  • Creator: Dr. Mindbender — Dr. Mindbender is Cobra's chief scientist.
  • Location: Cobra Island — Cobra Island is the sovereign capital Cobra claims.
  • Character: Serpentor — Serpentor seizes Cobra from Cobra Commander as a genetically built emperor.
  • Character: Zartan — Zartan leads the Dreadnoks in Cobra's service.
  • Faction: M.A.R.S. — M.A.R.S. supplies Cobra with vehicles and weapons.
  • Location: Springfield — Springfield hides a Cobra recruitment town in the comics.

What is Cobra?

Cobra is the enemy organization of A Real American Hero: a cult of personality under Cobra Commander, funded by Destro's arms, infiltrated by the Baroness, and staffed by faceless blue troopers.

Key threads lead to Cobra Commander, G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero, G.I. Joe team, The Baroness, Destro and Storm Shadow.
